facts.fact: The Board of the national regulator ARN-TIC, in Aviso n.º 01/CA/ARN/2026 (published 2026-05-08), opened a public consultation of 'interested parties' on the draft Electronic Transactions Law, with written responses by email due within 30 days, by 28 May 2026; the notice names no outside participants.
facts.system: Projeto de Lei das Transações Eletrónicas

note: Notice has no published comments or answer and does not say a law required the consultation (Lei n.º 5/2010 is cited only as the regulator's competence), so no answered or required fact.
